reviews.reason: A small destructive food examination is feasible without eating the sample. Existing probe observations and press trials do not expose internal tissue or provide a structured, evidence-limited food assessment. Develop that narrow precursor, not a universal toxicity detector: it can reveal actual deterioration and physical food structure, but cannot establish absence of toxins or quantify nutritional usefulness without a validated assay.
reviews.experienceReview: Successfully discovering previously unknown, actually measured internal condition can provide confirmed understanding; neither an inconclusive safety assessment nor learning the interface automatically does so. Extend the existing grounded-understanding subscription to qualified information-confirmed events from food-examination@1, with sol as the performing participant. Qualification requires a completed measurement establishing a new supported observation, deduplicated across probe and examination by subject, property and material condition. Reuse the same source, not an additional reward: amount 0.8, cap 1, duration 8 rounds, refresh repetition and 12-round cooldown. Repeated unchanged findings do not qualify. Maintain its existing gradual gain of 0.035 per qualifying event and decay of 0.0015 per round, bounded by the existing source saturation. Examination offers understanding, not eating pleasure or physical comfort; nutrition, health and survival remain independent.
reviews.visualReview: Show the actual sample being opened at sol's position, the retained tool when required, and a two-stage progress indicator. Render the opened sample using measured condition only; do not use a green safe badge or reveal hidden toxicity. Bind the opening animation to food-sample-opened and the evidence panel to food-examination-completed. Replay records must include sample quantity, source identity, paid energy, tool, observations, uncertainty and cancellation disposition so that visible effects correspond to actual execution.
reviews.specification: Implement food-examination@1 through the current Codex handoff. Public schema: {target:string, method:'open-inspect'}, required fields only, additionalProperties:false; target uses shared owned-item references and resolves to a persistent stack ID. Prerequisites: individual learning, an owned food sample of at least 0.1 resource unit, and sufficient energy. Soft material with hardness <=1 can be opened manually; harder samples require a real owned stone with hardness >=8, retained rather than consumed. No tool or sample is supplied. Execute two rounds at the actor's starting position, costing 0.5 energy per performed round and 0.1 sample unit. Escrow that fraction under the actor's ownership; record source, harvest time, decay, composition and any processing history. Round one opens/crushes the fraction; round two examines the exposed material. Implement measurable tissue-integrity and decomposition observations derived from actual material and spoilage state, not labels, nutrition or toxicity fields. Do not invent mold, pathogens or chemical test reactions. Return observed measurements, method, provenance and explicit limitations: no detected visible deterioration does not establish safety; tissue structure alone does not establish digestibility, calories or absence of toxins. Existing personally verified consumption records may be cited separately with their actual dose and observed outcomes, never generalized into a safety guarantee. The examined fraction becomes a traceable opened sample with conserved mass, nutrition, toxicity and decay history; opening grants no detoxification, healing or added nutrition. Return it as a fractional owned stack on completion. No room or terrain modification occurs; interaction and tool access use shared geometry and the 0.65 reach rule. State stores actor, resolved references, escrow, stage, paid costs, observations and remaining work. Global pause preserves state; loss of access pauses without further charges; explicit cancellation, movement or death cancels, returning untouched escrow once or retaining the already opened sample in inventory/on the ground under ordinary death rules. Never refund spent energy, clone material or delete escrow. Completion means one examination, and repeat starts another paid examination. Declare food-sample-opened and food-examination-completed events, with measured results and limitations; use process-progress and process-stopped for progress/cancellation. Reuse probe's measurement, provenance and knowledge-record code separately from the new function. Version retained records without changing existing press findings; implementation and review advance no simulation time and grant no mastery.
